about: Meprobamate 400 mg three times a day is supplied every month for nine months. The medicine has no Australian brand, so it appears by ingredient name.
Meprobamate 400 mg twice a day is supplied four times from January 2026 to March 2026, in the middle of a 15-month history.
Zoloft (sertraline, an antidepressant that is not on the list) is supplied every month. No meprobamate is supplied.
